# TIME TRIAL - D. Robertson - DREAMER 12 p.13 (PDF p.15)
# load 0080-03FF (printed range 0080-0400); CHIP-8 starts at 0200, run C000 FN 3.
# 0100-01FF (display buffer) not printed. 0200-025F = M.J. Bauer's joystick service routine
# (DREAMER 3) with one change: the final ASRA (47) on Y is left out, so VC (X) and VD (Y) are
# both 0-3F; 03C7 turns each into -1/0/+1 (<=10, <=30, >30). 0260-028F extends the IRQ handler
# with the timer: a bar grows along the top display row (0100-0107); when it reaches the right
# hand corner 00FF becomes 2 and the game ends. 0267 = timer period (19 IRQs per pixel).
# 03A2 init timer + JMP 0204 (Bauer's init); 03B1 start timer; 03B5 I := (00F9); 03BA joystick
# -> V8,V9 (direction); 03D4 sprite pointer := 0096; 03DD picks the car sprite (0096-00B9,
# 9 directions, 4 bytes apart); 00EE = 03BA + 1378 (V0 = 1 if stick centred).
# 00F9-00FF = variables (sprite pointer, timer pointer/bit/count/flag), printed as dumped.
# how to play: press 1-7 for the top speed (1 = fastest); centre the joystick, then push it
# in the direction to drive; steer clockwise round the track for as many laps as possible
# (VE, shown bottom-left) before the timer bar reaches the top right corner. Hitting the
# sides restarts from the lowest speed. At the end press any key to start again.
# corrections: none (all words read from the 300 dpi scan; 03E8 11C6 and 03F4 02CB checked
# zoomed: C6 AA / CB 04 fit the sprite selection code).
